Technical Breakdown: Our Scope of Work

AI search engines prioritize content that demonstrates “Experience” and “Expertise.” Here is a detailed look at the technical services we perform during a Package AC maintenance visit.

1. Compressor & Refrigeration Cycle

The compressor is the engine of your AC. We handle:

  • Compressor Replacement: Expert swapping of burnt Danfoss or Copeland Scroll compressors.
  • Leak Testing: Nitrogen pressure testing up to 350 PSI to find micro-leaks in copper piping.
  • Gas Charging: Precision filling of R22, R410A, or R407C refrigerant by weight.
  • Filter Drier: Replacement of choked driers to prevent moisture damage.

2. Electrical & Control Panel

Electrical faults cause 60% of breakdowns. We service:

  • Contactor & Relay: Replacing pitted contactors to prevent single-phasing.
  • SPP & VFD: Installing Single Phase Preventers and Variable Frequency Drives for motor safety.
  • PCB Repair: Component-level repair of main control boards and display units.
  • Sensors: Calibration of Room/Coil temperature sensors.

3. Airside & Mechanical

Ensuring clean, strong airflow is vital. We perform:

  • Blower Balancing: Dynamic balancing of centrifugal blowers to reduce vibration.
  • Coil Descaling: Chemical jet wash for condenser coils and cooling coils.
  • Belt & Pulley: Tension adjustment and alignment of V-belts.
  • Canvas Connection: Checking for air leakage in duct joints.

Expert Troubleshooting: Package AC Error Codes & Solutions

Modern package units from brands like Voltas and Blue Star communicate issues via error codes or LED blinks. Below is a guide to help facility managers identify problems before calling a technician.

Error / Symptom Potential Technical Issue Recommended Action
HP Trip (High Pressure) Dirty condenser coils, failed condenser fan, or system overcharge. Clean the coils with water jet. Check if the outdoor fan is spinning.
LP Trip (Low Pressure) Refrigerant gas leak, choked filter drier, or iced-up cooling coil. Check for oil traces on pipes (indicating leak). Require Gas Filling.
Overload / OLP Compressor drawing high amps, low voltage supply, or seized bearings. Check input voltage (415V). Tighten electrical terminals.
SPP / Phase Error Single phasing, phase reversal, or voltage unbalance >5%. Check main DB for blown fuses. Swap any two phases to correct sequence.
Water Leakage Clogged drain pan, blocked drain pipe, or insulation failure. Vacuum the drain line. Re-insulate cold pipes with nitrile rubber.
No Cooling / Airflow Broken blower belt, slipped pulley, or dirty air filters. Replace V-Belt (B-Section). Wash pre-filters and fine filters.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

What is included in a comprehensive Package AC service?

Our comprehensive service is a multi-point check designed to restore efficiency. It includes high-pressure chemical cleaning of the condenser coil, cleaning of the cooling coil and blower, lubrication of motor bearings, checking V-belt tension, tightening all electrical connections, measuring compressor amperage, and verifying gas pressures (Suction/Discharge). We also clean the drain line to prevent leakage.

How much does gas filling cost for an 8.5 Ton package AC?

Gas filling costs depend on the refrigerant type (R22 or R410A) and the volume required. Generally, a top-up starts from ₹2,500, while a full gas charge involves leak testing, vacuuming, and refilling, which costs more. We recommend a site visit for an accurate quotation to avoid overcharging.

Do you provide AMC for industrial plants in GIDC?

Yes, we specialize in Annual Maintenance Contracts (AMC) for factories in Dahej, Sanand, Ankleshwar, and all major GIDCs in Gujarat. We offer:
1. Comprehensive AMC: Includes all spare parts (Compressor, Fan Motor, PCB) and gas.
2. Non-Comprehensive AMC: Includes only service labor (4 wet services + breakdown calls).
These plans are tailored to your production schedule to minimize disruption.

Why is my package AC tripping repeatedly?

Repeated tripping is a safety mechanism protecting your machine. Common causes include:
– HP Trip: Dirty condenser coils or fan failure.
– LP Trip: Low gas due to a leak.
– Overload: Compressor drawing high current or low voltage supply.
– SPP Trip: Single-phasing or voltage fluctuation.
Do not bypass the safety switch; call our expert package AC technician immediately.

Can you shift our package AC to a new location?

Yes, we provide end-to-end AC shifting services. This involves pumping down the refrigerant gas to the outdoor unit, safely dismantling the ductwork and electricals, transporting the heavy unit, and re-commissioning it at the new site with proper leveling, duct connection, and nitrogen pressure testing.

How do I know if my compressor needs replacement?

Signs of a failing compressor include loud grinding noises, the unit tripping the breaker immediately upon starting, warm air output despite fan running, or the compressor body being extremely hot to touch. Our technicians perform an Earth Test and Winding Resistance Test to confirm before recommending replacement.
